layout: Bilingualism, Mother-tongue Tulu: rows = State (incl./excl. C&M Station), cities and districts; columns = Mother-tongue M/F (2-3), Total of subsidiary languages (4-5), subsidiary languages Kannada, Telugu, Hindustani, Tamil, Marathi, Banajari, Konkani (6-19), Two/Three/Four/Five subsidiary languages (20-27), each Males/Females. Most cells print an upright figure over an italic figure: upright = all speaking that subsidiary language (incl. multilinguals), italic = speaking only that one subsidiary language (italic flag in records). Cols 20-27 print italic figures only.
